subject: RetailWave AWS marketplace pricing adjudication
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@retailwave.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot request — AWS Marketplace tiered SKU discount

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. RetailWave is ready to move a pilot into procurement for our new in-store assistant use case. We plan a 12-month pilot across 120 stores (expected TCV ~$180k).

To make the marketplace private-offer economics work for our CFO, we need a one-time listing concession and a larger initial discount on the SKU bundle. Specifically, we're asking for a 35% marketplace listing/offer discount for the first 12 months so the effective price matches our procurement targets. AWS co-sell will be engaged — they prefer we use a private offer.

Attached is our PO draft and basic pilot SOW for reference (RW-Pilot-PO.pdf). Can Redwood make an exception on the marketplace listing and approve this level of discount? If not, what is the maximum concession you can offer and what approvals are required?

We're targeting a July 15 start, so procurement needs doc + pricing confirmed by next week. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Sophie Martin
Director, Strategic Procurement
RetailWave

---
Attachment: RW-Pilot-PO.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@retailwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-28T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — AWS Marketplace tiered SKU discount

Hi Sophie — appreciate the PO and the clarity on timeline. Short answer: we can entertain an exception but anything above our standard 25% marketplace concession requires Deal Desk review and finance sign-off.

Next steps from our side:
- I'm initiating a Deal Desk escalation and copying Sales Ops (Ben) and Finance (Marissa) to produce margin impact and an approval recommendation.
- Ben: can you run a quick pricing delta (attached calc preferred) and flag the break-even if we go to 35%?
- Marissa: can you advise whether Finance is open to a strategic concession for a named retail anchor (if the ARR and co-sell commitment are validated)?

Proposal for discussion: consider a phased concession — e.g., 30% for first 6 months with a review tied to usage thresholds, or a true 35% only if AWS co-sell commits to marketing/cofunding. That reduces our risk while helping RetailWave hit procurement targets.

Sophie — would RetailWave be open to a phased structure? If yes, we'll aim to have an internal decision by 6/30.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive — Retail
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-29T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — pricing delta and margin impact (RetailWave)

Vanessa / Marissa — ran the numbers, attaching a quick calc (pricing_calc.xlsx). Key points:

- List SKU (annualized) = $260,000
- Requested 35% concession -> net = $169,000 (delta = $91k, ~35% reduction)
- At 35% our gross margin on the SKU drops by ~18 percentage points relative to standard marketplace pricing; incremental cost mostly in COGS + co-sell credits.
- With a 30% concession net = $182k — still gets RetailWave close to target while preserving ~7 points more margin for us vs 35%.

Recommendation: approve up to 30% via Deal Desk. Anything >30% should require (a) formal exec/finance sign-off, (b) documented co-sell commitments from AWS (marketing spend or joint logos), and (c) a 6-month usage milestone tied to tranche payment.

If Sales wants to push to 32% as a middle ground for this strategic anchor, Finance (Marissa) will need to confirm the funding source for the margin shortfall (e.g., promotional budget or deal-specific rebate).

Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-30T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — RetailWave approval path

Vanessa / Ben — reviewed Ben's calc and the RetailWave profile. RetailWave is a strategic vertical reference for our retail push; I support a one-time exception with controls.

Approval summary:
- Approved concession: up to 32% for the first 12 months (one-time exception) conditional on:
  1) AWS co-sell confirmation (email from AWS rep committing to co-marketing or private-offer facilitation),
  2) Signed SOW and PO (RetailWave to sign DocuSign envelope below),
  3) Internal promotional budget to absorb the remaining margin impact (Marketing/Promotion line).

Action items:
- Vanessa: secure AWS co-sell confirmation and have retail procurement sign the PO.
- Ben: finalize pricing package in HubSpot and prepare a private-offer artifact for AWS listing.
- Neha: please confirm whether any additional compliance (data residency / SOC2 evidentiary items) are required before we accept marketplace listing controls.

I've uploaded a signed approval stub (approval_form.pdf) to the deal and initiated a DocuSign envelope for the SOW: https://www.docusign.com/edocs/DocuSign-Envelope-RW-2026-014

I'll route this to Finance lead for final monetary sign-off once AWS confirms co-sell. Given timing, we can close by 7/2 if RetailWave returns the signed PO today.
